notes.title: [Event] Beat the Dev Win a Steam Key
notes.content:
Beat the Dev event starting now!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31859798/a33926c22eb84b083d34aacca19c29eace4b0dab.png

What:
Win a free Steam Key of Ghost Platoon for your friends.

When:
Now!

Where:
Join the Deathmatch-Server called [EVENT] Beat the Dev with the player named [Polygon Art] on it.

Rules:

    Kill limit: 20
    Time limit: 10min
    Winner is who scores first 20 Kills or who is leading on timeout
    Each player has only one chance
    Steam Key is delivered ingame via chat (screenshot it) after match end and will not be send via mail or private messages afterwards.


Scoreboard screenshots of all matches will be attached to this post at the end of the event.

While stocks last, no guarantee for participation. Matches will be recorded and be used for promotional purposes.
